Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.speech_async(LiterLlm::CreateSpeechRequest.new(input: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', model: 'tts-1-hd', response_format: 'mp3', speed: 1.0, voice: 'nova'))
puts result.inspect
```
